mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_alert_occurrence(occurrence_type, metric_code, dimension_key, fact_status, source_entity_id, fact_key, evaluation_snapshot, evaluation_time, created_at) VALUES('CLUSTER_MUTATION_COMMAND', #{row.operation}, #{row.commandFingerprint}, 'PENDING', #{row.targetId}, #{row.factKey}, JSON_OBJECT('requestId',#{row.requestId},'commandFingerprint',#{row.commandFingerprint}), NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, fact_key, metric_code operation, dimension_key command_fingerprint, source_entity_id target_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(evaluation_snapshot,'$.requestId')) request_id, fact_status, CAST(evaluation_snapshot AS CHAR) evaluation_snapshot FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type = 'CLUSTER_MUTATION_COMMAND' AND fact_key = #{factKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_occurrence SET fact_status = 'COMPLETED', evaluation_snapshot = CAST(#{snapshot} AS JSON), resolved_at = NOW(3), evaluation_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND occurrence_type = 'CLUSTER_MUTATION_COMMAND' AND fact_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_alert_occurrence(occurrence_type, metric_code, metric_value, dimension_key, sample_count, fact_status, source_entity_id, related_entity_id, fact_key, resolution_note, resolved_by, resolved_at, evaluation_snapshot, evaluation_time, created_at) VALUES('CLUSTER_REVIEW_DECISION', #{row.decisionType}, #{row.overturned}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.candidateCount}, #{row.decisionType}, #{row.sourceId}, #{row.selectedClusterId}, #{row.factKey}, #{row.reason}, #{row.reviewerId}, NOW(3), CAST(#{row.snapshot} AS JSON), NOW(3), NOW(3))
